Call-over-Wi‑Fi marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Wi‑Fi Calling in iOS Settings — not a literal paste of US carrier marketing:

Listing copy should mirror that vocabulary — not Wi‑Fi Assist data handoff claims or Personal Hotspot tethering when your app only references carrier voice-over-Wi‑Fi.

Wi-Fi Calling vs Wi-Fi Assist

Wi‑Fi Assist uses cellular data when Wi‑Fi connectivity is poor on the same device — 无线局域网助理. Wi‑Fi Calling lets buyers place and receive carrier phone calls over Wi‑Fi — 无线局域网通话.
